# What will the EU carbon border levy (CBAM) cost on your steel, aluminium, cement or fertiliser imports?

> Free CBAM cost estimator for EU importers of steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers and hydrogen: embedded emissions, free-allocation phase-out 2026 to 2034, certificates needed, cost per tonne, and the 50-tonne threshold. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
